The royal guard on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Gala]] used a type of siege vehicle called '''proton tanks'''. They were equipped with an [[Ion cannon/Legends|ion cannon]] as well as [[Proton grenade/Legends|proton grenade]] launchers.
